findings.title: Internal lines split one foundation into multiple foundations
findings.body: BuildLoops extracts every bounded graph face rather than preserving the original CAD outline. If a line on S-FND connects two opposite edges of a rectangular footing, traversal produces two smaller rectangular faces. Both pass ProcessPoints because the dividing line is part of each face boundary, so the command places two undersized foundations instead of the single foundation represented by the outer rectangle.

findings.title: Unrelated same-layer linework suppresses valid foundations
findings.body: The parser rejects a rectangle whenever the midpoint of any loose line lies strictly inside it, without checking whether that line belongs to the candidate loop or represents another valid CAD object. Consequently, a disconnected center mark, annotation segment, nested outline, or other S-FND line inside an otherwise valid footing causes that footing to be silently omitted. This makes extraction dependent on incidental layer contents and prevents reliable automatic placement from typical CAD drawings.
